rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card, impostor table and dated predictions before real data; synthetic validation on the real 25 boundaries in both models (found the placebo-correction null bias; Amendments A1-A3; showed the newcomer clause unpowered); replication with 12 preprocessing and rival variants; three natives (NE27, NE32, NE15 in-flight placebo); two post hoc mechanism checks; scorecard; frozen, guarded confirm script with a C2 for the post hoc finding, dry-run, not run.
rationale.faithfulness: The endogenous loading is 3x the null in both models and robust to every variant, and it is not wrap-up. But the model's own form fails: no decay within 5 days (P3), part of the asymmetry is H81's slow mode, and the agent's own previous content absorbs it (the HH's individual-memory kill, post hoc). Read > unread in one model. Scorecard A1 B0 C2 D1 E1 F2 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: Tells an operator that a goal change does not erase the previous goal: expect about a week of carry-over of each veteran's own threads, partly through what it reads; resetting a specific agent's context is the lever. It refutes the strong egregore reading (record-borne remanence) at this sample size rather than establishing it.

one_line: The previous goal leaves a persistent day-1 trace (dgamma ~0.15, 3x null, 25 boundaries) that does not decay within 5 days and is carried by each agent's own previous content, not the village record.
